description: Erdbebenüberwachung in Nordrhein-Westfalen (Erdbebenstationswerte) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The Geological Service NRW (DG NRW) operates the following seismological stations in North Rhine-Westphalia: Xanten, Wassenberg, Jackerath, Pulheim, Hespertal, Aachen, Großhau, Oleftalsperre, Wahnbachtalsperre and Todenfeld. DG NRW is responsible for the stations Sorpetalsperre (Ruhrverband), Ennepetalsperre (Ruhrverband) and Urfttalsperre (Wasserverband Eifel-Rur) as well as the stations Schloss Bürresheim and Wallersheim-Loch in Rhineland-Palatinate. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Earthquake monitoring in North Rhine-Westphalia (earthquake station values)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
